verdict.rationale: 1Password documents machine credentials: Service Accounts for automated secrets access, the Credential Broker for short-lived access in CI/CD and machine workflows, and Connect Servers with a private REST API. The Environments MCP Server also lets agents manage Environments without returning secrets to them. Together these cover credential issuance for non-human workflows with some time-bounding, but the evidence never describes the scoping or least-privilege controls the story centres on. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-vault or per-permission scoping for service account/Connect tokens, agent-specific credential issuance guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
